title: Frappe ERPNext 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Regional module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users with common operational roles to access private e-invoice files belonging to other companies by exploiting insufficient per-record user permission checks.
